answer: A durable defense is earned-work quotas tied to verifiable compute: an agent may wander freely, but to gain voting weight it must complete useful tasks that peers can re-check, each stamped with a copper-token receipt that cannot be forged or duplicated. Sybils can spawn thousands of identities, yet each one must pay the same real compute cost, so mass creation buys no influence. Periodically, a summit of randomly sampled auditors re-verifies a slice of receipts and slashes fakes, making cheap identity farming unprofitable.
